description: Global crypto market snapshot: total market cap and 24h volume (in a chosen currency), BTC/ETH dominance, active-coin and active-market counts, ongoing ICOs, and 24h market-cap and volume change. One call for the macro picture — no coin id needed.

vs_currency.description: Currency for total market cap and volume (e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc"). Defaults to "usd". Dominance and the change percentages are always USD-denominated upstream.

name: coingecko_get_global

btcDominance.description: Bitcoin share of total market cap, as a percentage.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unsupported_currency`: The requested vs_currency is absent from the /global per-currency maps — /global has no upstream vs_currency validation, so an unknown code returns no totals. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

ethDominance.description: Ethereum share of total market cap, as a percentage.

marketCapChangePercentage24h.description: 24-hour change in total market cap, as a percentage (always USD-denominated).

totalMarketCap.description: Total crypto market capitalization in vs_currency.

updatedAtUnixSec.description: Snapshot time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

volumeChangePercentage24h.description: 24-hour change in total volume, as a percentage (always USD-denominated).

title: coingecko-mcp-server: get global
